collection_description: All four curated structures in this collection represent the human Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor (EGFR / P00533) kinase domain in different conformational states, complexes, or mutational profiles (wild-type, active, inactive, and drug-resistant T790M/V948R). They do not represent four independent protein targets.

structures.mutation_notes: SEQADV lists cloning-artifact residues 666-670; no engineered amino-acid substitution is annotated for the protein chain.
structures.verified_structure_description: EGFR tyrosine kinase domain with erlotinib; annotated component AQ4.
